items.title: 8.4 Reflection ke tareeqe se polarized light (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.4 with Fig. 8.6 and Example 8.1 (PDF 177-178).

blocks.text: 1808 mein Malus ne daryaft kiya ke jab aam light sheeshe ki hamwar sheet se mun'akis ho (sath se laut aaye) to polarized light milti hai. Agar mun'akis light ko aise polaroid se dekha jaye jise nazar ki lakeer ke gird aahista ghumaya ja raha ho, to polaroid ki ek position par light taqreeban bujh jati hai. Sheeshe ke liye munasib tareen angle of incidence i taqreeban 57 degrees hai, jis par mun'akis shua (ray) plane polarized ho jati hai, jaisa Fig. 8.6 ke ray diagram mein hai. Yeh sabit karta hai ke sheeshe se mun'akis light taqreeban plane polarized hai. Mez ki sath se mun'akis light ghumaye polaroid se dekhne par gehri ho jati hai, jo dikhata hai ke woh juzvi plane polarized hai.

blocks.title: Polarizing angle
blocks.text: Shaffaf (transparent) medium par woh khaas angle of incidence jis par mun'akis light taqreeban plane polarized ho, polarizing angle theta_p kehlata hai.

Unpolarized light ki beam medium 2 ki sath par dali jaye (Fig. 8.6). Agar mun'akis beam taqreeban plane polarized ho to polarizing angle i = theta_p par mun'akis aur refracted beams ek doosre ke amudi hoti hain. Yun theta_p + theta_r = 90 degrees, ya theta_r = 90 degrees - theta_p. Snell ke qanoon se n1 sin theta_p = n2 sin theta_r = n2 sin(90 degrees - theta_p) = n2 cos theta_p, to sin theta_p / cos theta_p = n2/n1, yaani tan theta_p = n2/n1.

blocks.title: Brewster ka qanoon
blocks.text: tan theta_p = n2/n1, jahan n1 medium 1 aur n2 medium 2 ka refractive index hai. Agar medium 1 hawa ho to n1 = 1 aur n2 = n, to tan theta_p = n, jahan n us medium ka refractive index hai jis par light parti hai. Lihaza Brewster ne sabit kiya ke jab medium 1 hawa ho to angle of polarization ka tangent adadi taur par medium 2 ke refractive index ke barabar hai. Brewster ke qanoon mein woh angle theta_p jis par mun'akis aur refracted shuaon ke darmiyan 90 degrees ka zawiya ho, Brewster angle theta_B bhi kehlata hai; tab tan theta_B = n.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: unpolarized light polarizing angle par sheeshe se takrati hai, mun'akis shua plane polarized aur refracted shua ke 90 degrees par, Brewster ke qanoon ke saath. Oopar daen: angle ke muqable guzarti intensity ka graph jo I0 cos murabba theta par chalta hai, aur amplitude A0 ke analyzer ke saath A0 cos theta aur aar paar A0 sin theta hisse. Neeche baen: polarized light analyzer se pehle optically active namoone se ghoomti hai. Neeche daen: polarization ke istemalat.
blocks.caption: Reflection se polarization, Brewster ka qanoon, Malus ka qanoon aur optical activity (Figures 8.6 se 8.8 aur topics 8.4 aur 8.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Jab unpolarized light polarizing angle, taqreeban 57 degrees, par sheeshe se mile to mun'akis light sirf sath ke mutawazi vibrate karti hai aur mun'akis aur refracted shuaein amudi hoti hain, to polarizing angle ka tangent refractive index ke barabar hai. Analyzer tak zawiya theta par pohanchti polarized wave apne amplitude ka sirf analyzer ke axis wala hissa, A0 cos theta, rakhti hai, to guzarti intensity I0 cos murabba theta hai: 0 degrees par poori, 90 degrees par koi nahi. Cheeni ke mehlool jaise optically active maadde polarization ki satah ghumate hain, utna jitna maadda, us ka arhaaz, raste ki lambai aur wavelength tay karein.

blocks.text: Malus ka qanoon hayatiyati (biological) nizamon mein light ki polarization, jaise cell membranes se light ki polarization, parhne ke liye bhi istemal hota hai (Interesting Information).

blocks.title: Example 8.1
blocks.text: Light ki ek beam sqrt 3 refractive index wali sheeshe ki plate ki sath se polarizing angle par takrati hai. Light ki wave ka angle of refraction kya hoga? Hal: n = sqrt 3, theta_r = ?. Chunke tan theta_B = n, theta_B = tan^-1 (sqrt 3) = 60 degrees. Chunke theta_r = 90 degrees - theta_B, theta_r = 90 degrees - 60 degrees = 30 degrees.

blocks.caption: Brewster angle ke rishte
rows: n1 sin theta_p = n2 sin theta_r

blocks.prompt: Hum 1.5 refractive index wali sheeshe ki plate ko hawa mein polarizer ke taur par istemal karna chahte hain; polarizing angle aur angle of refraction nikalein. Pani (n = 1.33) se mun'akis light kis angle of incidence par poori polarized hogi (numerical 8.7, 8.8)?
blocks.explanation: theta_p = tan^-1 1.5 = 56.3 degrees aur theta_r = 90 - 56.3 = 33.7 degrees. Pani ke liye theta_p = tan^-1 1.33 = 53 degrees.

items: Malus (1808): sheeshe se mun'akis light polarized hai; sheeshe ke liye taqreeban 57 degrees par plane polarized; mez ki sath ki light juzvi polarized.

Polarizing (Brewster) angle par mun'akis aur refracted shuaein 90 degrees par: theta_p + theta_r = 90 degrees aur tan theta_p = n2/n1 = n (hawa se). Example 8.1: n = sqrt 3, theta_B = 60 degrees, theta_r = 30 degrees.
